item.title: As IDF and Hamas dig in, interim Gaza armistice line risks hardening into lasting border
item.description: Yellow Line was meant to be temporary, pending Hamas disarming; but with the terror group clinging to its weapons, the army is unlikely to withdraw, keeping the precarious stalemate in place The post As IDF and Hamas dig in, interim Gaza armistice line risks hardening into lasting border appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: US soldiers who served near Gaza adopt abandoned dogs
